component.name: Periferia
component.summary: Push-to-talk microphone gated by a key
Микрофон по клавише: говорит, пока держишь

description.p: Periferia gates your microphone behind a key. The microphone stays muted until you hold the key you chose, so nothing is sent unless you are deliberately talking.
It can also repurpose keys per application, so the same physical key does one thing on the desktop and another in a game, without the game being started a particular way.

ul.li: Push to talk on any key, with a panic key to cut out immediately
A config checker that names problems before they bite
Available as one AppImage file, nothing to install

description.p: First release with per-application key remapping and config checking.
